[SWS_DM_00433] Refusal of diagnostic request due to busy Diagnos- tic Conversation
⌈
If a UDS request is assigned to a Diagnostic Conversation
that has not finished processing of a formerly assigned UDS request, then the
Diagnostic Server instance shall ignore the new UDS request according to
[SWS_DM_00386].
⌋
